entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie, I need to start a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought recently.

I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm heading in the right direction, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a preference issue?
It's not faulty, it works fine. It's just not what I was expecting in terms of the feel on my wrist. I know I'm a few days past the return window, but I have a bit of a special circumstance.

Okay, I understand. Let me pull up your account. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 29th, which was 14 days ago. For that specific device, we do have a strict 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and account activation. What was the circumstance you mentioned?

Exactly. I tried to return it last Wednesday, which would have been day 9. I went on the website to start the process, but there was a major website error. The whole returns portal was down. I couldn't print the label or even get a confirmation number. The entire system seemed to be down.
I see. You said you tried last Wednesday, January 7th? Let me check our system status logs for that day.
Yes, it was definitely the 7th. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I figured this might happen.

Thank you for being so thorough. You are absolutely correct; our records show we had a known system down issue with the returns portal for several hours that day. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience. Since it was a business fault that prevented your timely return, I can absolutely approve an exception for you.
Okay, great. I appreciate you looking into that and making it right. A full refund is what I was hoping for.
Of course. I'm processing the return authorization now and will email you the pre-paid shipping label right after our call. You'll just need to box it up and drop it at the post office.

That's good. Now, since I had to spend time dealing with the website error and then calling in today, is there any possibility of a small store credit or a discount code for my trouble? I'm still a VeloFit customer and buy other things here.

I understand the request, and I do apologize for the time you lost due to our system issue. However, our policy in this situation is to make the customer whole by providing the full refund they were entitled to. The exception for the full refund is the resolution we can offer for the website issue.
I see. So no goodwill credit at all? I'm not asking for much, maybe a 15% off code for my next jersey purchase. It seems like a fair trade for the hassle.

I can see your point of view, but my system is limited here. I am authorized to grant the full refund as an exception, but I'm not able to add a financial credit on top of a return for a non-defective item. My priority is ensuring you get your money back for the band without any issues.
Alright, Charlie, I hear you. A full refund is the main thing. I had to try. Thanks for getting the return approved.
You're very welcome. I've just sent that return label to the email on your account. Please let me know if there's anything else I can assist with today.
No, that's everything. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
